newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index up on Slovnaft intra-day gains.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index up on Slovnaft intra-day gains.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Major Slovak shares close mostly unchanged in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Tuesday, with gains in the average price of refiner Slovnaft pushing the SAX index higher.

*Slovakofarma up 100 crowns at 5,100, Slovnaft closes unchanged at 1,000 but average price 2.7 percent higher than Monday, Nafta NAFT.BV up nine at 1,670 crowns, VUB Bank VSEO.BV unchanged at 1,701, VSZ unchanged at 700 crowns
